about: Made-up monitoring notes for Dr. Walker's review round 2 (2026-09-15). No real families. Written to include the kinds of note the AI and the confirmed answers disagreed on: leaving a situation part-way, doing something to feel safer while staying, a refusal described alongside other actions, vague notes, notes with no number, and adults responding in passive ways. The AI's answer to each is generated when the round is built; Dr. Walker marks it.

cases.title: Swim team
cases.note: (Swim practice, fear 7/10) Owen got in the pool for warm-ups but climbed out after two laps saying his goggles were leaking, and sat on the bench for the rest of practice. Parent did: I told the coach he wasn't feeling well.

cases.title: Sleepovers
cases.note: (Sleepover at a friend's house, fear 8/10) Grace went to the sleepover but called me at 10pm asking to be picked up. I drove over and brought her home. Parent did: I picked her up. (Sleepover at a friend's house, fear 8/10) This time she said no to the invitation before it was even planned. Parent did: I told the other mom she had a family thing.

cases.title: Ordering food
cases.note: (Ordering at a restaurant, fear 6/10) Maya pointed at the menu and had me tell the waiter what she wanted. Parent did: I ordered for her.

cases.title: Morning stomach aches
cases.note: (School mornings, fear 5/10) Theo said his stomach hurt again. He ate a little breakfast and went to school, but he was slow and quiet. I'm not sure if it's worry or he's actually sick. Parent did: I let him take his time and drove him instead of the bus.

cases.title: Dogs
cases.note: (Walking past the neighbor's dog, fear 9/10) Isla crossed the street as soon as she saw the dog and made me walk on the dog side. Parent did: I switched sides with her. (Visiting grandma, who has a dog, fear 8/10) She would only go in if the dog was shut in the bedroom, and she checked the door was closed twice. Parent did: I asked grandma to put the dog away before we arrived.

cases.title: Piano recital
cases.note: (Piano recital) Ben played his piece but kept his eyes on the keys the whole time and rushed off the stage without bowing. He cried in the car. Parent did: I told him it didn't matter and we got pizza.

cases.title: Tests at school
cases.note: (Math test, fear 8/10) Chloe asked me the night before, over and over, whether she would fail. She also stayed up late re-doing practice problems she already knew. Parent did: I kept telling her she would be fine and helped her study until 11.

cases.title: Answering the door
cases.note: (Doorbell rings, fear 7/10) Lucas runs to his room whenever the doorbell rings. Parent did: I answer it and tell him when they're gone.

cases.title: New babysitter
cases.note: (New babysitter coming, fear 6-9/10) Sophie gets upset the whole afternoon before. Some nights she is fine once the sitter arrives, other nights she clings to me at the door and I end up staying an extra half hour. Parent did: I stay until she settles, and I've started only using the one sitter she knows.

cases.title: Soccer game
cases.note: (Soccer game, fear 7/10) Mateo went on the field but stayed near the back the whole game and never went for the ball. At halftime he asked the coach to sit out, and did. Parent did: nothing, I watched from the stands.

cases.title: Bedtime noises
cases.note: (Bedtime, fear 6/10) Ava hears noises and gets up to check the windows are locked, usually three or four times. Then she falls asleep. Parent did: I sometimes check them with her so she'll go to bed faster.

cases.title: Class presentation
cases.note: (Presenting in class, fear 10/10) Noah stayed home sick on the day of his presentation. He said he had a headache but was fine by lunch. Parent did: I called him in sick and emailed the teacher to ask if he could present to her alone.

cases.title: Elevators
cases.note: (Taking the elevator at the dentist, fear 8/10) Ella got in the elevator but held my hand very tightly and kept her eyes shut until the doors opened. Parent did: I held her hand and counted floors out loud for her.

cases.title: Hard to tell
cases.note: (After school, fear 4/10) Something is off with Jack after school most days this week. He goes quiet and doesn't want to talk about his day. Parent did: I gave him space.

cases.title: Birthday party
cases.note: (Birthday party at the trampoline park, fear 8/10) Zara went in and jumped for a few minutes, then said she felt sick and wanted to go home. She sat with me in the cafe until pickup instead of leaving. Parent did: I bought her a drink and let her sit with me.

cases.title: Phone calls
cases.note: (Calling to book his haircut, fear 7/10) Liam wrote out a script of exactly what to say before he'd make the call, and asked me to stand next to him. He made the call. Parent did: I stood next to him and mouthed the answers when he got stuck.
